description: This file defines an interface 'IProviderRuntime' in the Orleans framework. The interface provides properties and methods for provider components to access runtime services such as grain factory, dependency injection, and extension binding.

classes.name: IProviderRuntime
classes.description: Interface for provider callbacks to runtime services, including access to grain factory, dependency injection, and extension binding.

methods.name: BindExtension
methods.description: Binds an extension to an addressable object; constructs and retrieves the extension and its reference.
